description: Check status or state colors for color-vision problems. Pass `states` as lines or comma-separated entries such as `error: #d32f2f, success: #2e7d32`, or an array of {label, color}. Labels like error, success, warning and info (and close variants) get matching icon and text suggestions; any other label gets generic ones. Every pair is compared by CIE76 deltaE under normal vision and simulated protanopia, deuteranopia and tritanopia (Machado et al. 2009, full severity). Under 10 counts as merged and under 20 as weak, both working conventions. Returns each pair's numbers, the worst case, a lightness gap, and a second cue per state with a reminder of WCAG 1.4.1 (Use of Color) and 1.4.11 (non-text contrast for the icon). Simulation covers dichromacy only; milder anomalous trichromacy falls between.

states.description: State colors with labels: "error: #d32f2f, success: #2e7d32" or an array of {label, color}.
